permanent sampling designs provide the best available information on the sustainability performance of forests and that the information provided by permanent sampling designs is adequate to satisfy the need for information on the multiple functions of forest.

permanent sampling designs can satisfy the need of information concerning the sustainability of forest management in a wide range of applications.

the use of permanent sampling designs in forest inventories is not restricted to the provision of information on the sustainability and productivity of timber production.
